agents.reader:
---
name: reader
description: Reads the project
tools: Read, Bash
---
Read and report.

arguments.command: echo MAIN $BASH_VERSION; git init -q && git add . && git -c user.name=t -c user.email=t@t commit -qm init && git log --oneline | wc -l

echo CHILD $BASH_VERSION; "$SYSTEMROOT/System32/whoami.exe" //groups | grep -o 'Mandatory Label.\{0,30\}'; cat README.md | tr a-z A-Z; echo t > "$TEMP/t.txt" && cat "$TEMP/t.txt"; echo TEMP=$(cd "$TEMP" && pwd -W); echo x > new.txt && echo CREATED || echo create refused; git --version; git log --oneline; git status --short; echo status=$?
echo HOME=$HOME; sleep 1 & wait; echo bg-ok; exit 3
